summary: @ornikar/rollup-config 11.1.8 preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: Version 11.1.8 of @ornikar/rollup-config declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that runs at install time. setup.mjs uses obfuscator-style identifiers (`_0x...`) and does one of two things: if a local `bun` binary is available, it invokes it on the shipped `math_init.js`; otherwise it downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, chmods it 0755, and execFileSyncs it against `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB Bun-compiled CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose body is a rotated string-array decoder and opaque hex-named code — its behavior is not auditable from source. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is mentioned in the package README or CHANGELOG (last documented release is 11.1.1); the plain library source `createRollupConfig.js` does not use obfuscated identifiers, and the install-time behavior does not appear in the public github.com/ornikar/shared-configs repository history. The install-time-execution pattern (fetch an alternate runtime specifically to run an obfuscated bundle whose contents cannot be reviewed) is inconsistent with the package's stated purpose of providing a shared Rollup configuration and is consistent with a compromised/tampered release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
